BiblicalUsage: Gozan is the land on the Euphrates where Assyria settled the exiles taken from Israel. It stands in the record of the fall of Samaria, a place name that marks where the northern kingdom ended.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gozan matters because God's story happened in real places, and Gozan is one of them.
